about: BATCH 14 ENTRY 31 (the legal-links half; the grade-count cells are graded by gate 139 TC-R215zz). Gate 47 block L (CT_BLK=L, TC-MN-057): at 375x761 (kunal761, ct_safe 51,31) and 320x568 the menu's four legal links (Privacy, Terms, Refunds, Delete account) each take a hit-tested tap of 44 down their centre line (the box stays 40 by design: ct-hit44 grows the tap and the sheet fits one screen with 1px to spare), the sheet still fits one screen (scrollHeight <= clientHeight), the foot button keeps its 44, and no app error. Three ways it could come undone: ct-hit44 gone from all four links; gone from Delete account only; the 4px row gap at vp.w<360 gone so Terms over Delete account overlap at 320. NOT COVERED: other widths between 320 and 375, text sizes above 100 percent, iOS Safari, his own look.
